scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'public/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('index.js')) fs.copyFileSync('index.js', 'public/index.js'); if(fs.existsSync('server.js')) fs.copyFileSync('server.js', 'public/server.js');"
